boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Long Island campus spaces documented by New York Tech sources, spanning study, making, student events, and academic gatherings.

cards.title: Salten Hall Library
cards.subtitle: Salten Hall, Rooms 300 and LL01
cards.notes: Start with a research question, then use the library’s study-room booking and Ask a Librarian options to plan a focused work session.
cards.short_summary: A campus library stop with research help, technology services, and reservable study space.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies Salten Hall Library at Salten Hall Rooms 300 and LL01 and lists study-room booking, 3-D printing, and research help.
cards.source_title: Salten Hall Library | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Located on the Long Island campus; consult the library page for current service details and booking.

cards.title: Art & Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Education Hall, Room 101
cards.notes: Bring sketches or a design brief and use the collaborative tables, workstations, and architecture, art, and design collections for project research.
cards.short_summary: A design-focused library with collaborative tables, seating, and campus workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says the Art & Architecture Library has study space, collaborative work tables, seating, printers, scanners, and computer workstations.
cards.source_title: Art & Architecture Library | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Education Hall, Room 101; the library serves the School of Architecture and Design and the broader campus community.

cards.title: Medical Library–Long Island
cards.subtitle: NYIT de Seversky Mansion Annex, Room 112
cards.notes: Use this named satellite library when your coursework needs medical-library resources; confirm current access and assistance arrangements before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The Long Island medical-library location is in the de Seversky Mansion Annex.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech lists its Medical Library–Long Island as a satellite medical library in the NYIT de Seversky Mansion Annex, Room 112.
cards.access_notes: Medical Library–Long Island, NYIT de Seversky Mansion Annex, Room 112; contact the library for access details.

cards.title: Bear’s Den
cards.subtitle: Student Activity Center, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Look for student-organization programming here; a 2024 campus report documented a CyberHack and ACM hackathon in this Student Activity Center space.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Activity Center venue documented as a site for a student coding event.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech reported that CyberHack Club and ACM held a hackathon at the Bear’s Den in the Student Activity Center on the Long Island campus.
cards.source_title: CyberHack & ACM Hosts their First Hackathon of the Year! | Inside Engineering
cards.access_notes: Inside the Student Activity Center; availability depends on scheduled student and campus programming.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship & Technology Innovation Center
cards.subtitle: Harry J. Schure Hall, Room 107
cards.notes: Watch for student project, hackathon, or design-challenge opportunities, and contact ETIC for space or program questions before arranging a visit.
cards.short_summary: An innovation hub where ETIC projects give students practical experience and professional connections.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech lists ETIC at Long Island Campus HSH 107 and identifies active student programs including hackathons, design challenges, and entrepreneurship.
cards.source_title: Labs and Facilities | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Harry J. Schure Hall, Room 107; contact ETIC for space inquiries and participation details.

cards.entity_name: IDC Foundation Digital Fabrication and Robotic Matter Design Labs
cards.title: Digital Fabrication and Robotic Matter Design Labs
cards.subtitle: Education Hall, Room 274
cards.notes: Complete the required orientation and supervisor training before using equipment, then bring a project question for a consultation with the lab staff.
cards.short_summary: A supervised maker space with digital fabrication, robotics, and model-making equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech lists the Long Island Fabrication Lab in Education Hall Room 274 and requires orientation, training, and a waiver before first use.
cards.access_notes: Education Hall, Room 274; access is governed by orientation, training, waiver, and school or director approval requirements.

cards.entity_name: Midge Karr Fine Arts and Design Center
cards.title: Midge Karr Fine Arts and Design Center
cards.subtitle: Long Island campus
cards.notes: Use the center’s documented digital-art facilities as a starting point for class projects; verify room access with the relevant program or instructor.
cards.short_summary: A Long Island digital-art facility with motion capture, sculpture, photography, and graphics workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says the Midge Karr Fine Arts Design Center and nearby Sculpture Studio include motion capture, digital sculpture, photography, and graphics workstations.
cards.access_notes: Program facilities on the Long Island campus; room and equipment access may be course- or instructor-controlled.

cards.title: Sculpture Studio
cards.subtitle: Near Midge Karr Fine Arts and Design Center
cards.notes: Pair a visit with a digital-art project discussion and confirm studio access with your class or program before bringing materials or equipment plans.
cards.short_summary: A nearby studio building included in New York Tech’s Long Island digital-art facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies the nearby Sculpture Studio building as part of the Long Island facilities serving digital art and design.
cards.access_notes: Near Midge Karr Fine Arts and Design Center; confirm studio access and safety requirements with the program.

cards.title: SAC Field
cards.subtitle: Student Activity Center Field, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Check the university events calendar before going; this named field is a useful outdoor reference point for scheduled campus activities.
cards.short_summary: The event-calendar venue for the Student Activity Center Field in Old Westbury.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech’s event venue page identifies SAC Field as the Student Activity Center Field on the Long Island campus in Old Westbury.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Long Island campus venue; use the events calendar to check whether an activity is scheduled.

cards.title: NYIT de Seversky Mansion
cards.subtitle: Long Island campus historic estate
cards.notes: Look for academic events or class-connected programs rather than assuming public access; the mansion has hosted student-focused awards and learning events.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus mansion used for academic events and student learning experiences.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech states that the de Seversky Mansion hosts academic events and that its annual School of Management gala gives hospitality-management students planning experience.
cards.source_title: Our History | NYIT de Seversky Mansion
cards.access_notes: Historic campus event venue; access depends on university classes, events, and venue arrangements.
